shortDescription: Print sanitized debug statements with automated regex redactions

options.name: additional_key_patterns
options.description: Additional collection of regular expressions to append to the default evaluation arrays.

options.name: key_patterns
options.description: List of regular expressions used to identify and redact sensitive keys.

options.name: msg
options.description: A customized string message to print out. Mutually exclusive with the C(var) option.

options.name: var
options.description: A variable name string or complex data structure to evaluate and print out. Mutually exclusive with the C(msg) option.

options.name: verbosity
options.description: A number that controls when the debug module will run based on the defined verbosity level configurations.
